segments.ja484:1.3: Paṭivedemi te brahme, na ne [te (sī. syā.), naṃ (sī. syā. pī. aṭṭha.), taṃ (ka. aṭṭha.)] vāretumussahe.
segments.ja484:2.1: Eko ca tattha sakuṇo, yo nesaṃ [tesaṃ (sī. aṭṭha.)] sabbasundaro;
segments.ja484:3.1: Oḍḍentu [ujjhuntu (syā. ka.) aṅguttaranikāye passitabbaṃ] vāḷapāsāni, yathā vajjhetha so dijo;
segments.ja484:3.3: Jīvañca naṃ gahetvāna, ānayehi [ānayetha (sī. pī.)] mamantike.
segments.ja484:4.1: Ete bhutvā pivitvā ca [bhutvā ca pitvā ca (pī.)], pakkamanti vihaṅgamā;
segments.ja484:4.3: Eko baddhosmi pāsena, kiṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā.
segments.ja484:5.1: Udaraṃ nūna aññesaṃ, suva accodaraṃ tava;
segments.ja484:6.1: Koṭṭhaṃ nu tattha pūresi, suva veraṃ nu te mayā;
segments.ja484:6.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kuhiṃ sāliṃ nidāhasi [nidhīyasi (pī.)].
segments.ja484:7.1: Na me veraṃ tayā saddhiṃ, koṭṭho mayhaṃ na vijjati;
segments.ja484:7.5: Nidhimpi tattha nidahāmi, evaṃ jānāhi kosiya.
segments.ja484:8.1: Kīdisaṃ te iṇadānaṃ, iṇamokkho ca kīdiso;
segments.ja484:9.3: Te maṃ bhatā bharissanti, tasmā tesaṃ iṇaṃ dade.
segments.ja484:10.1: Mātā pitā ca me vuddhā, jiṇṇakā gatayobbanā;
segments.ja484:10.3: Tesaṃ tuṇḍena hātūna, muñce pubbakataṃ [pubbe kataṃ (sī.)] iṇaṃ.
segments.ja484:11.3: Tesaṃ puññatthiko dammi, taṃ nidhiṃ āhu paṇḍitā.
segments.ja484:12.1: Īdisaṃ [edisaṃ (sī. pī.)] me iṇadānaṃ, iṇamokkho ca īdiso;
segments.ja484:12.3: Nidhinidhānamakkhāmi [nidhiṃ nidhānaṃ akkhātaṃ (sī. pī.)], evaṃ jānāhi kosiya.
segments.ja484:13.3: Ekaccesu manussesu, ayaṃ dhammo na vijjati.
segments.ja484:14.1: Bhuñja sāliṃ yathākāmaṃ, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja484:14.3: Punāpi suva passemu, piyaṃ me tava dassanaṃ.
segments.ja484:15.1: Bhuttañca pītañca tavassamamhi [tavassabyamhi (ka.)], rattiñca [ratī ca (sī. pī.)] no kosiya te sakāse;
segments.ja484:15.3: Nikkhittadaṇḍesu dadāhi dānaṃ, jiṇṇe ca mātāpitaro bharassu.
segments.ja484:16.1: Lakkhī vata me udapādi ajja, yo addasāsiṃ pavaraṃ [yohaṃ adassaṃ paramaṃ (syā. ka.)] dijānaṃ;
segments.ja484:16.3: Suvassa sutvāna subhāsitāni, kāhāmi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja484:17.1: So kosiyo attamano udaggo, annañca pānañcabhisaṅkharitvā [annañca pānaṃ abhisaṃharitvā (ka.)];
segments.ja484:17.3: Annena pānena pasannacitto, santappayi samaṇabrāhmaṇe cāti.
